reasoning_summary: Phase F — Control Center Dashboard. Created 7 new files. No existing files modified (except session_index.json). Dashboard is a read-only FastAPI server on port 8899 with 12 API endpoints and 8 panels: System Health, Architecture Lock, Pipeline Flow (configurable), Architecture Overview, Active Tasks, Bug Tracker, Memory Layer, Future Roadmap. Pipeline flow is driven by dashboard_config.json (configurable nodes/edges/colors). Integrates with core.bootstrap.startup_enforce() and core.architecture_validator.run_architecture_validation() at startup. Also created MASTER_PLAN.md (architectural roadmap) and DECISIONS.md (6 ADR records). Architecture validation confirms 0 CRITICAL violations — only 9 expected HIGH warnings from deprecated scripts.
system_state_before: No visual control center. Observability limited to command-line tools and state files.
system_state_after: Control Center Dashboard running on port 8899. 8 visual panels. 12 API endpoints. Read-only. Integrated with bootstrap + architecture_validator.
